About us

Built by someone who has done the work

Brian spent twenty years in construction before writing a line of this. GoFindBuild is built in Indianapolis and works across central Indiana, for the firms and the trades that never found each other on a job board.

Twenty years on site

Brian watched good crews go unfilled while good workers went unfound. The same week, every week, on both sides of the same fence.

Learn More: Twenty years on site

Hiring never got easier

Job boards returned resumes with no licence check. Agencies took a cut of every hour worked. Small firms had neither the time nor the budget for either.

Learn More: Hiring never got easier

So we built the connection

One profile for workers. One post for companies. Nobody in the middle taking a cut of anyone's hours.
